## NO CHANGE. Newest release family is still **Australia**; AI Control Tower still at
## **Australia Patch 4** (page updated March 12, 2026). Identical to the 08-14, 08-21, 08-23 captures.
The family index confirms Australia is newest and carries NO per-application AI links — it only says
"The Australia release includes new features and improvements built on the ServiceNow AI Platform."
This is exactly why the index cannot be used for change detection.

## Australia Patch 4 feature set (all previously reported)
- **Activity Center** — centralizes governance tasks and recommendations across AI Control Tower
- Recommendations and AI insights
- Monitor quality and safety for AI systems (automated scoring + trend analysis)
- **Trace connections** — collects data from **AWS, Azure and Google Cloud**
- Plan AI strategy / prioritize / execute — portfolio planning in one workspace
- Conversational interface (ServiceNow Otto premium chat with web search)
- **AI agent containment using KILL SWITCH PROTOCOL** — deactivates rogue agents ACROSS PLATFORMS
- **Agent network MAP** — visualizes AI models, MCP servers and providers
- Configure post-runtime security metrics (system prompt leakage, threat monitoring)
- Specify asset state during AI asset creation
- Review AI risk and compliance posture
- New connectors for **Anthropic** (2.0.7) and **Amazon**; Microsoft integration improvements
  (Google connector 1.2.4)

## Resolved watch item, carried
AI Control Tower ships in the **Australia** release via the ServiceNow Store; **AI Gateway is
DEPRECATED and no longer supported** — the "GA expected August 2026" forecast was superseded, not
met. Australia also introduced **MCP Server Console**, which turns a ServiceNow instance into a
governed MCP SERVER exposing Subflows, Actions, REST APIs, Knowledge Graphs and Now Assist skills as
tools. Control Tower can DEACTIVATE AGENTS IN AWS BEDROCK AND GCP VERTEX AI from ServiceNow.
